title: SpeedFix
description: SpeedFix patches the Soul Speed III glitch on Paper servers that allows unintended speed boosts.
body:
# ⚡ SpeedFix – Soul Speed Glitch Patch
SpeedFix is a lightweight Paper plugin designed to fix a common exploit caused by Soul Speed III, where players can gain unintended and unfair speed boosts by rapidly equipping armor.
This plugin ensures fair gameplay by preventing the glitch entirely and giving admins a quick way to fix players who have already abused it.

## 🚫 What Problem Does It Fix?

On some Paper servers, players can abuse Soul Speed III by repeatedly equipping and unequipping boots to stack or retain abnormal speed.
This results in:
Unfair PvP advantages
Broken movement balance
Exploitable mechanics in survival and minigames
### 
✅ How SpeedFix Solves It

## SpeedFix uses a simple but effective approach:
- ⏱️ 1-second cooldown on armor equipping: Prevents rapid re-equipping, which is the root cause of the glitch.
- ⚡ Instant speed normalization: Stops players from keeping bugged speed values.
- 🛠️ Admin command to fix affected players: Already glitched? No problem.
- 🧰 Commands: /speedfix <player>
- Instantly removes the bugged speed boost from the specified player.

## 🧰 Commands

```
/speedfix <player>
```

## 💡 Why Use SpeedFix?
Instead of disabling Soul Speed or heavily modifying movement mechanics, SpeedFix targets only the exploit itself.
Your players keep the intended enchantment behavior while the unfair advantage is removed.
